scope: Målrettet lokal nettleser-/tastatur-/tekstavstandskontroll av /informasjonskapsler/ og /ressurser/informasjonskapsler-og-samtykke/. Ny axe-regresjon på 23 ruter og Nu/HTML på 25 eksportfiler. Tidligere vurderinger videreføres med opprinnelig omfang og dato; ingen ny full manuell revisjon av alle sider eller 48 krav.

results.result: DOM, contrast, reflow, keyboard and declared states completed without candidate. Two routes, six viewport measurements, 16 Tab steps, two actual Enter flows.

results.method: Full forward/reverse keyboard sequence and skip-link activation
results.result: 20 forward + 20 reverse transitions on cookie-page; 16 + 16 on skill-page. Stop at first/last product link, not developer tools. Both skip links move actual focus to MAIN#innhold. Final footer link outline rgb(157,241,173) solid 3px. No trap or unexpected sequence observed.

results.method: Text spacing with temporary source CSS and visual review
results.result: Four measurements at 320/1280 ×800: applied 1.5 line-height, .12em letters, .16em words, 2em paragraph margin confirmed. No page overflow, clipped headings or lost content observed; long words/code wrap. Source CSS restored byte for byte.

One named H1 per page, ordered H2 sections, ordinary links and lists. Cookie side has descriptive external authority links, privacy link and mailto; skill side has ordered five-step instructions, visible Beta status and wrapped example. Norwegian prose with technical identifiers. DOM/AX is not actual screen-reader reading. No forms, media or consent banner on the two pages.

technical_failure.reason: Initial 32-Tab attempt passed beyond page controls and locator body timed out; keyboard part errored on both routes. Preserved rather than reported successful. Successful 8-step re-run and controlled full forward/reverse walkthrough recorded separately.

limitations: Actual screen reader and speech not tested.
Physical rotation, OS reduced motion, native hover and other browser combinations not tested. Previous native Chrome access was rejected, not re-requested.
No consent banner exists; banner keyboard/dialog/choice behavior cannot be tested.
No authentication, external model API or production deployment in scope.
PDF structural helper repeated; no new manual PDF or language/reading-order assessment.
New catalog axe incomplete nodes on homepage require continued manual contrast review.
